request: Compare CDN delivery cost savings with URL-only non-subscriber denial, preserving live membership and media authorization.

sources.title: AWS external authorization
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Viewer request calls authorization before serving cached or S3 bytes; fail-closed chosen for crefans.

sources.title: CloudFront trigger order
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Viewer request runs before cache lookup; origin request does not run on cache hits.

sources.title: CloudFront signed cookies
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: URL-independent time-limited authorization; default validation does not query live subscription DB.

sources.title: Google Cloud signed cookies
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Cross-provider support; unsigned requests and origin protection require explicit handling.

sources.title: CloudFront OAC
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Private origin access scoped to distribution; does not replace viewer authorization.

sources.title: Edge runtime differences
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Lambda@Edge supports network calls; CloudFront Functions does not.

sources.title: Edge combination restrictions
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Cannot mix Lambda@Edge and CloudFront Functions in viewer events of the same behavior.

sources.title: CloudFront flat pricing
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Free USD0; Pro USD15 per distribution per month.

sources.title: CloudFront plan allowances and restrictions
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: Free 100GB/1M requests; Pro 50TB/10M; Lambda@Edge available all tiers with extra usage charges; sustained excess can affect delivery; custom caching/response policies need higher tiers.

sources.title: CloudFront usage pricing
sources.review: manual official-page read through web tool
sources.finding: AWS origin to CloudFront USD0/GB; Lambda@Edge USD0.60 per million and USD0.00005001 per GB-second.

excluded: S3 storage and requests after applicable plan credits

verification.method: Python Decimal assertions of documented price arithmetic; source and current-code manual review

notPerformed: New architecture prototype, security integration, latency or load tests
Actual bill or cost savings measurement
currentVsProposed: S3 API streaming remains current. Lambda@Edge viewer authorization with S3/CloudFront bytes is a proposal requiring implementation and fail-closed cache-hit testing.

documentationVerification.command: npm run docs:record && npm run check:docs && npm run test:docs
documentationVerification.scope: Document inventory, contracts, links, change detection only; not a runtime security or deployment test.
